searchText: Hey guys, a quick question, what are the bare minimum hardware requirements to run a lighthouse beacon node along with execution for a testnet? Like RAM, storage.. which testnet? Holesky Holesky has a pretty big state, so at least 8gb of ram, recommended 16gb. Current disk usage is about 200GB. 84GB EL - 115GB CL (including blobs)
